digest.component_or_area: differ mutation filtering at production snapshot call site
propositions: A4-1 filters differ-owned field_drift and unbound_local mutations immediately after the raw differ at the production snapshot call-site boundary without breaking the pure differ contract
The raw differ emits its documented field-drift positive control while the production snapshot call site filters it to zero outbound updates
A converged pass with the filter in place records mutation_count == 0 and exactly zero per-mutation git rev-parse calls
The A4-1 call-site design requires no new code and preserves load-bearing raw-differ tests and existing positive controls
Genuine inbound-create and invariant-seed mutations survive the filter while field-drift mutations from remote-to-remote snapshot comparison are suppressed
